title: NAMC National Conference: one site to attend, sponsor or exhibit
summaryLead: The 2027 conference site for NAMC Wisconsin, built on the 2026 B2B Forum site.
story: NAMC Wisconsin is hosting the 58th National Conference in Milwaukee, June 28 to 30, 2027. The forum site they'd been using was mostly text and links. The schedule and the map were behind buttons, and sponsor levels barely got a mention. We started the new one with a question: what are you here to do? Attend, sponsor or exhibit, with the price on each card. The rest of the page backs up one of those three. It's navy, red and gold on warm paper, set in Bebas Neue over Barlow.
goals: Ask visitors what they came for and send them there.
Show prices right away: $400 early bird, $5,000 to $50,000 for sponsors, $1,500 for a booth.
Keep dates, venue and gala pricing in one place, with Register and Add to Calendar.
